project_name: SababaKids - Israel Family Activity Discovery App

theme.vibe: Warm Mediterranean sunset, playful yet trustworthy, map-centric, parent-first efficiency

playgrounds.title: Park Park Hayarkon Playground - Tel Aviv

beaches.title: Gordon Beach Family Lagoon - Tel Aviv

header.style: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-stone-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/50
header.left: Logo with SababaKids icon + Israel Flag indicator + Location selector pill
header.right: Favorites Counter Badge, Language Switcher (EN/FR/HE), Dark Mode Toggle, Profile Avatar

main_discovery_modes: Map View (Interactive leaflet/mapbox or styled canvas map with custom pin markers)
List / Grid View (High-density cards with photo preview, distance badge, tags, and quick-favorite button)
Events Calendar View (One-off events sorted by upcoming weekend/date)

quick_pills: Child Age (0-2 baby, 3-5 toddler, 6-9 kid, 10-14 teen)
Category (Parks, Museums, Playgrounds, Zoos, Beaches, Water Parks, Indoor Play)

bottom_nav_mobile.visible: md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-stone-200 dark:border-slate-800 px-4 py-2 flex justify-around items-center

key_components.location_search_header: City/Address autocomplete + 'Use my GPS Location' button + Radius indicator badge
key_components.interactive_map: Map pins with category icons, cluster counts, pulse animation on active pin, bottom swipeable sheet preview card
key_components.activity_card: Rounded-2xl card with overflow-hidden image, distance badge, age tag, indoor/outdoor indicator, star rating, free/paid pill, and quick save icon button
key_components.activity_detail_drawer: Full height slide-over/modal with photo gallery, operating hours, age suitability, stroller accessibility, parking availability, weather recommendation, Google Places link, Waze/Maps direction buttons
key_components.one_off_events_section: Weekend specials carousel / grid with date badge, time, booking status, and age recommendation
key_components.favorites_manager: Localstorage backed list with quick export / WhatsApp share list for family trips

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: ALL interactive buttons, search inputs, radius sliders, category pills, card items, map pins, and tabs MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app feels incredibly slick, fast, and parent-friendly with zero setup friction.
Provide robust mock/fallback data for Google Places and Israeli local events (Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, Haifa, Eilat, Sharon, Galilee) so the map and list are immediately full of rich activities.
Integrate real GPS geolocation API browser requests with standard Tel Aviv default coordinates fallback.
Include age filter toggles (0-2, 3-5, 6-9, 10+) and clear Free/Paid and Indoor/Outdoor badges on every card.
Support dark mode smoothly via Tailwind dark: classes and state toggle.
Follow responsive mobile-first guidelines with floating action bar on mobile viewports.
